items.title: Palo Alto Networks to buy AI startup Applied Compute for $4.5B in all-stock deal
items.summary: Palo Alto Networks announced on 18 Nov that it will acquire Applied Compute in an all-stock deal valued at $4.5B. Applied Compute is a platform for post-training and inference of open-weight AI models. CEO Yash Patil becomes Co-Chief AI Officer at closing. Closing expected in fiscal Q3 2027 pending regulatory clearance.

sources.name: Palo Alto Networks press release (SEC 8-K Ex. 99.2)

items.why_it_matters: One of the larger AI M&A deals of the week; incumbents pay high prices for enterprise AI infrastructure.
